descriptions.AcidicConcoctionPlayer: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area. The thrown flask [Consume|Consumes] [Poison] on [Hit] to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
descriptions.AlchemistsBoonPlayer: While active, grants you [Flask] charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your [Flask|Flasks] to also apply to [Allies] in your [Presence].
descriptions.AlignFatePlayer: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your [Spell|Spells] from your first valid [WeaponSets|Weapon Set]. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same [Spell] aligns your fate, [Empowered|Empowering] that [Spell]. Visages can only cast damaging, non-[Channelling], non-[Buff] [Spell|Spells] you could cast that have no cooldown.
descriptions.AmazonTriggerElementalSurgePlayer: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.
descriptions.AncestralCryPlayer: Perform a [Warcry] using [Glory] gained by [Ignite|Igniting] enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you [Trigger] Volcanic Steps while travelling, [Melee] [Strike|Strikes] and [Slam|Slams] are [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted], and your [Melee] [Strike|Strikes] [Trigger] Volcanic Eruption.
descriptions.AncestralCryProjectilePlayer: Fire molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the struck enemy, which will land nearby dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
descriptions.AncestralCryShockwavePlayer: [Slam] the ground around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
descriptions.AncestralSpiritsPlayer: This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] each time you summon a [Totem|Totem], summoning an Ancestral Spirit [Minion] to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.
descriptions.AncestralWarriorTotemPlayer: Consume 3 [Charges|Endurance Charges] to Raise a [Totem|Totem] that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed [Mace] Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use [Channelling] Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
descriptions.AncientGiftsPlayer: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].
descriptions.AnimusExchangePlayer: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].
descriptions.ApocalypseFirePlayer: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing [Fire] damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.
descriptions.ApocalypseLightningPlayer: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing [Lightning] damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final [Lightning] strike.
descriptions.ApocalypsePlayer: Build [Glory] by [Hit|Hitting] enemies with [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage. When you have maximum [Glory], you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, [Trigger|Triggering] one of multiple powerful [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Skills at an interval while this [Buff] lasts.
descriptions.ArcPlayer: An arc of [Lightning|Lightning] stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and [Chain|Chains] on to other nearby enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to deal more damage and [Chain] further.
descriptions.ArchmagePlayer: While active, causes your Non-[Channelling] [Spell|Spells] to cost additional mana and deal extra [Lightning] damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
descriptions.ArchonOfChayulaPlayer: Build [Glory] by dealing [Chaos] damage to enemies. When you have maximum [Glory], you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his [Archon].
descriptions.ArchonOfChayulaTornadoPlayer: Conjure a [Chaos] tornado that chases down and [Slow|Slows] enemies.
descriptions.ArcticArmourPlayer: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals [Cold] [Spell] damage to the attacker.
descriptions.ArmourBreakerPlayer: [Strike] with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their [Armour|Armour].
descriptions.ArmourPiercingBoltsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and [ArmourBreak|Break enemy Armour]. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
descriptions.ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer: Rapidly fire bolts that [ArmourBreak|Break enemy Armour]. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
descriptions.ArtilleryBallistaPlayer: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that rains down a salvo of [Pinned|Pinning], [Maim|Maiming] bolts.
descriptions.AttritionPlayer: While active, causes you to deal more [Hit] damage to [Rarity|Rare] and [Rarity|Unique] enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain [CullingStrike|Culling Strike] against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
descriptions.AzmerianSwarmPlayer: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] or hit [Rarity|Rare or Unique] enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments]. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that pursue nearby enemies to [Attack] them and inflict [FaerieFire|Faerie Fire] on [Hit].
descriptions.BallLightningPlayer: Fire a slow-moving [Projectile] that moves through enemies. The [Projectile] itself does not [Hit] enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of [Lightning] at nearby enemies. Consumes a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to slow down over time, create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] as it travels, and explode dealing [Fire] damage in an Area after it dissipates.
descriptions.BarkskinPlayer: While active, taking [Hit] damage from enemies to your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] causes you to gain [Armour] for a short duration. [Armour] gained from multiple [Hit|Hits] can stack. The total [Armour] gained from this Skill cannot exceed the [ItemArmour|Item Armour] on your [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items].
descriptions.BarragePlayer: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow|Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear|Spear] [Attack|Attack] to [Repeat] multiple times. Consumes your [Charges|Frenzy Charges] on use to add additional repeats.
descriptions.BearFuryOfTheMountainPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and repeatedly pound the ground, creating [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
descriptions.BearMaulPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and rake enemies with your claws, generating [Rage] on [Hit].
descriptions.BearRampagePlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and charge forward, [Slam|Slamming] the ground as you run. [Channelling] ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending [Rage].
descriptions.BerserkPlayer: While active, strengthens your [Rage], but causes you to lose Life while not losing [Rage].
descriptions.BitterDeadPlayer: Spend [Ward] and target an area, transforming [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.
descriptions.BlackPowderBlitzReservationPlayer: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that [Blind|Blinds] and [Ignite|Ignites] enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.
descriptions.BlasphemyPlayer: Turn socketed [Curse] skills into vile [Aura|Auras], applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
descriptions.BleedingConcoctionPlayer: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area and [Aggravate|Aggravating Bleeding] on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
descriptions.BlinkPlayer: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
descriptions.BlinkReservationPlayer: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
descriptions.BloodBoilPlayer: Enemies in your [Presence] accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] to enemies near them.
descriptions.BloodHuntPlayer: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a blood explosion and also [Consume] [Bleeding]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
descriptions.BloodhoundsMarkExplosionPlayer: A violent explosion of blood that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage.
descriptions.BloodhoundsMarkPlayer: [Mark] a target, making them suffer [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] build up from [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark] will [MarkActivate|Activate], [Consume|Consuming] itself to [Trigger] Blood Explosion, when they are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned], or when they are killed if they suffered enough [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark]'s duration does not expire while the [Mark|Marked] target is suffering [BloodLoss|Blood Loss].
descriptions.BoneBlastPlayer: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing [Bleeding].
descriptions.BoneCagePlayer: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and [Pinned|Pinning] those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
descriptions.BoneOfferingPlayer: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your [Minion|Minions] while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from [Hit|Hits]. Taking a [Hit] that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that [Minion|Minion's] shield to absorb all damage from that [Hit], then explode.  The bone spike is itself a [Minion], and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other [Minion|Minions] disappear.
descriptions.BoneshatterPlayer: Attack enemies with a melee [Strike|Strike]. The [Strike|Strike] will cause a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. Upon causing a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
descriptions.BonestormPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel [Impale|Impales] enemies [Hit], causing subsequent [Attack] [Hit|Hits] against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your [Charges|Power Charges] to cause much larger explosions.
descriptions.BriarpatchPlayer: While active, a portion of the [Physical] [Attack] damage you deal is stored. Casting a [Spell] uses the stored damage to create a patch of [ThornyGround|Thorny Ground] that deals [Spell] damage to moving enemies.
descriptions.ChaosSpearTriggerChaosSurgePlayer: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.
descriptions.ChargeRegulationPlayer: While active, you gain powerful [Buff|Buffs] based on your active [Charges]. However, maintaining the [Buff] Consumes [Charges] every few seconds.
descriptions.ChargedStaffPlayer: Consume all [Charges|Power Charges] to charge your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] with electricity, adding [Lightning|Lightning] damage and a [Lightning|Lightning] shockwave to your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] [Attack|Attacks]. Reusing this skill while the [Buff] is active adds to the [Buff]'s duration and damage.
descriptions.ClusterGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini [Grenade|Grenades] that explode when they come to a stop.
descriptions.CoilingBoltsPlayer: Simultaneously fires a [Physical] [Projectile] and a [Chaos] [Projectile] at the target. These projectiles [Chain] through any number of [Curse|Cursed] targets.
descriptions.CombatFrenzyPlayer: While active, grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] when you [Freeze], [Electrocute] or [Pinned|Pin] an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.
descriptions.CometPlayer: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.
descriptions.ConductiveRunesPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a number of [Hazard|Hazardous] Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal [Attack] damage that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage and apply [Electrocute|Electrocution] buildup.
descriptions.ContagionPlayer: Afflict a single enemy with a [Debuff] that deals [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, [Curse|Curses], and other [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time [Debuff|Debuffs] on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the [Minion] or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
descriptions.ConvalescencePlayer: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin [ESRecharge|Recharging] [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and gain a [Buff] for a duration that prevents that [ESRecharge|Recharge] being interrupted. The [Buff] is removed at maximum [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and the skill cannot be used while [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is full.
descriptions.CorpseBeetlesPlayer: Harness Kelari's power to passively [Consume] [Corpse|Corpses] in your [Presence], causing Corpse Beetle [Minion|Minions] to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until [Command|Commanded]. On your [Command], they rush the target and explode.
descriptions.CorpseCloudPlayer: Consume a [Corpse] to create a cloud of flammable [Poison|Poisonous] gas. Any [Burning|Burning] effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
descriptions.CracklingPalmPlayer: When you [Hit] with [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], calls down lightning bolts which deal [UnarmedDamage|Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies.
descriptions.CrossbowRequiemAmmoPlayer: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your [Crossbow] shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use [Ammunition].
descriptions.CrossbowRequiemPlayer: Unleashes a torrent of anguish that bombard the target area, dealing damage in an area on impact. Does not use [Ammunition] and can be fired freely until the Requiem ends.
descriptions.CrushingFearPlayer: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.
descriptions.CullTheWeakPlayer: Dash to an enemy and run them through, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. If this [Attack] kills at least one enemy, it grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge], with higher [Rarity] monsters granting additional [Charges]. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.
descriptions.CurseOfRepulsionPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to [Curse] enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. [Hit|Hitting] these enemies removes the [Curse] to [Trigger] an explosion, [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and causing more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility on the target [Hit].
descriptions.CurseOfRepulsionShockwavePlayer: Deals [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area around the [Curse|Cursed] target that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage. Other targets are [Knockback|Knocked back] and take more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility they have.
descriptions.DarkEffigyPlayer: Raise a [Totem] that bombards enemies afflicted by [Chaos] damage over time [Debuff|Debuffs].
descriptions.DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer: Fire a [Projectile|Projectile] at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a [Chaos] damage over time [Debuff]. Fires multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] at enemies afflicted by multiple [Debuff|Debuffs], but [Projectile] count cannot be otherwise modified.
descriptions.DefianceBannerReservationPlayer: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [Armour], [Evasion] and movement speed.
descriptions.DemonFormPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your [Spell|Spells]. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a [Spell], or reactivate this Skill.
descriptions.DespairPlayer: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Chaos|Chaos] [Resistances|Resistance].
descriptions.DetonateDeadPlayer: Cause a [Corpse] to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
descriptions.DetonateLivingPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause a destabilising [Hit] against an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold], making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold].
descriptions.DetonatingArrowPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a [Detonator|Detonating] explosion at the end of its flight.
descriptions.DisciplinePlayer: Emit an [Aura] that grants you and [Allies] in your [Presence] additional [Total] [EnergyShield|Energy Shield].
descriptions.DisengagePlayer: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. [Consume|Consumes] the [ParriedDebuff|Parried Debuff] on [Hit|Hitting] enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes [Strike|Strikes] and [Projectile|Projectiles] to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
descriptions.DoomBlastPlayer: Deal [Chaos] damage in an area around the previously [Curse|Cursed] enemy.
descriptions.DreadBannerReservationPlayer: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold], [MaximumResistances|Maximum Elemental Resistances] and [Flask] charges.
descriptions.EarthquakePlayer: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] that slows enemies. The [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts in a powerful [Aftershock] after a duration. Cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
descriptions.EarthshatterPlayer: [Slam|Slam] the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. [Warcry|Warcries] performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.
descriptions.ElectrocutingArrowPlayer: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on [Hit]. [Hit|Hitting] an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming [Lightning|Lightning] damage to build up [Electrocute|Electrocution]. This rod is removed when the enemy is next [Electrocute|Electrocuted].
descriptions.ElementalConfluxPlayer: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable [ElementalDamage|Elemental] power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen [ElementalDamage|Element]. The [ElementalDamage|Element] affected changes frequently, though the same [ElementalDamage|Element] can be affected multiple times in succession.
descriptions.ElementalExpressionTriggeredPlayer: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your [Strength], for a bolt proportional to your [Dexterity], and for a wave proportional to your [Intelligence].
descriptions.ElementalStormPlayer: Create a stationary [Fire], [Cold] or [Lightning] storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] type for the [Hit] that [Trigger|Triggered] the storm. [Hit|Hits] which do not deal [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] will not [Trigger] the storm.
descriptions.ElementalSunderingPlayer: Plunge your [Spear] into the ground to emit a pulse that [Consume|Consumes] [Freeze], [Shock] and [Ignite] on a number of nearby enemies, [Allies] and [Corpse|Corpses]. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each [ElementalAilments|Ailment] [Consume|Consumed] causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
descriptions.ElementalWeaknessPlayer: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances].
descriptions.EmberFusilladePlayer: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing [Fire] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that [Chain] to enemies.
descriptions.EmergencyReloadPlayer: Instantly reload all your [Crossbow] [Ammunition] clips and [Empowered|Empower] each clip's [Ammunition] to deal more damage for a duration.
descriptions.EncaseInJadePlayer: Consume all stacks of [Jade] to grant [Guard] based off your maximum Life for each [Jade] consumed. You cannot gain [Jade] stacks while you have [Guard].
descriptions.EnervatingNovaPlayer: Unleash a [Nova] of [Lightning] damage to [Electrocute] enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies [Hit] can be [Electrocute|Electrocuted] by all [Lightning] damage for a short duration.
descriptions.EnfeeblePlayer: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.
descriptions.EntanglePlayer: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and [Slow|Slowing] them.
descriptions.EscapeShotPlayer: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can [Chill] or [Freeze] enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on impact.
descriptions.EssenceDrainPlayer: Fire a [Projectile|Projectile] that applies a powerful [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.
descriptions.EternalMarchPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.
descriptions.ExplodingPoisonToadPlayer: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing [Attack] damage in an area and inflicting [Poison].  Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon].
descriptions.ExplosiveConcoctionPlayer: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Fire] [Attack] damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby [Ignite|Ignited] Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
descriptions.ExplosiveGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
descriptions.ExplosiveShotAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.
descriptions.ExplosiveShotPlayer: Fire a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.
descriptions.ExplosiveSpearPlayer: Hurl a single payload [Spear] that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The [Spear] will explode at the end of its [DetonationTime|Detonation Time] or if [Detonator|Detonated]. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground].
descriptions.ExplosiveTransmutationPlayer: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.
descriptions.ExsanguinatePlayer: Expel your own blood as [Chain|Chaining] blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies [Hit] by the tendrils take [Physical] damage and are inflicted with [Bleeding].
descriptions.EyeOfWinterPlayer: Fire a single Eye [Projectile] which does not [Hit] enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard [Projectile|Projectiles] in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] or [Orb], it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding [DamageTypes|Type].
descriptions.FallingThunderPlayer: Suffuse your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] with electrical energy, then [Slam] the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your [Charges|Power Charges] to fire [Lightning|Lightning] [Projectile|Projectiles] forwards from the impact.
descriptions.FangsOfFrostPlayer: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a [ParriedDebuff|Parried] target [Consume|Consumes] the [Debuff] to cause an explosion of frost and leave [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].
descriptions.FeastOfFleshPlayer: [Consume] [Corpse|Corpses] near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per [Corpse] [Consume|Consumed].
descriptions.FerociousRoarMetaPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and roar in defiance, immediately gaining [Rage] if there are enemies nearby and [Empowered|Empowering] subsequent [Attack|Attacks] to [ArmourBreak|Break Armour]. Alternatively, socketing a human-form [Warcry] into this Skill triggers that [Warcry] instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.FireballPlayer: Launch a large ball of [Fire|Fire] which explodes on impact. The explosion [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
descriptions.FireboltPlayer: Launch a fiery [Projectile] towards a target. The [Projectile] explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.
descriptions.FirestormPlayer: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can [Consume] all three types of [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusion], creating a much larger storm when [ElementalInfusion|Fire-Infused], causing lightning bolts when [ElementalInfusion|Lightning-Infused], and raining ice bolts when [ElementalInfusion|Cold-Infused].
descriptions.FlameWallPlayer: Create a wall of [Fire|Fire] in front of you, which [Ignite|Ignites] everything within its area. Any [Projectile|Projectiles] fired through the wall by you and [Allies] deal added [Fire|Fire] damage. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to also add [Lightning] damage to the [Projectile|Projectiles].
descriptions.FlameblastPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you [Channelling|Channel] for.
descriptions.FlashGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a [Blind|Blinding], [Stun|Stunning] explosion when its fuse expires.
descriptions.FlickerStrikePlayer: Teleport to an enemy and [Strike] them. Consumes [Charges|Power Charges] to perform additional teleporting [Strike|Strikes] on nearby enemies.
descriptions.ForgeHammerPlayer: Hurl a fiery hammer that [Slam|Slams] into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a [Warcry] near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] in a spiral.
descriptions.FortifyingCryPlayer: Perform a [Warcry] that grants [Guard] and [Trigger|Triggers] Shield Wave when subsequent Shield [Attack|Attacks] deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.FragmentationRoundsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a [Frozen] enemy [Consume] the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] cause it to explode. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.FragmentationRoundsPlayer: Fire [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a [Frozen] enemy [Consume] the [Freeze] and cause an explosion of ice shards. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.FragmentsOfThePastPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and [Trigger|Triggers] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].
descriptions.FreezingMarkPlayer: [Mark] a target, making them more susceptible to being [Frozen]. When the [Mark|Marked] target is [Frozen], the [Mark] [MarkActivate|Activates], granting you a [Buff] which gives extra [Cold] damage and [Consume|Consuming] the [Mark]. [Mark|Marking] another target while you have the [Buff] will remove the [Buff].
descriptions.FreezingSalvoPlayer: Passively gains [Seal|Seals] over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the [Seal|Seals], [Repeat|Repeating] for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it [Repeat|Repeats] normally, it will also [Repeat] an additional time targeting a different [IceFragment|Ice Fragment] in its area of effect if able, [DetonationTime|Detonating] those [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] immediately.
descriptions.FreezingShardsPlayer: Launch icy [Projectile|Projectiles] in a sweeping arc. Multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] can hit the same enemy.
descriptions.FrostBombPlayer: Create a pulsing [Orb] of frost. Each pulse inflicts [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Exposure|Exposure] on nearby enemies. When the [Orb]'s duration ends, it [DetonationTime|Detonates], dealing [Cold|Cold] damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion].
descriptions.FrostDartsPlayer: Conjures a number of icy [Projectile|Projectiles] that launch towards the target. [Projectile|Projectiles] that [Hit] a [Chill|Chilled] or [Frozen] target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause each [Projectile] to lodge into the enemy then explode.
descriptions.FrostWallPlayer: Create a wall of [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] which holds back enemies. The [IceCrystals|Crystals] explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to add another [Lightning] explosion if destroyed.
descriptions.FrostboltPlayer: Fire a slow-moving [Pierce|Piercing] [Projectile|Projectile] that is effective at [Chill|Chilling] enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
descriptions.FrostflameNovaPlayer: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto [Ignite|Ignited] enemies, refreshing the duration of their active [Ignite] and rapidly [Freeze|Freezing] them but preventing them from being [Ignite|Ignited] further until the [Ignite] expires.
descriptions.FrozenLocusPlayer: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the [IceCrystals|Crystal] is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
descriptions.FulminatingConcoctionPlayer: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Lightning] [Attack] damage in an area with high chance to [Shock]. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
descriptions.FulminationPlayer: While active, the first time any Skill [Hit|Hits] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in your [Presence], that Skill also [Hit|Hits] other [Shock|Shocked] enemies in your [Presence], up to a maximum.
descriptions.FuriousSlamPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and [Slam] the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend [Rage] to create larger shockwaves that leave behind [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground].
descriptions.GaleStrikePlayer: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be [Daze|Dazed] and [Knockback|Knocked Back] based on how close they are to you.
descriptions.GalvanicFieldBuffPlayer: Gain a [Buff] that boosts your [Shock] chance. [Shock|Shocking] an enemy consumes the [Buff] to attach an [Orb] of electricity to that enemy. The [Orb] fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
descriptions.GalvanicShardsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams when they [Hit] enemies. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.GalvanicShardsPlayer: Rapidly fire charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams when they [Hit] enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.GasArrowPlayer: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a [Detonator] skill or if an [Ignite|Ignited] enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
descriptions.GatheringStormPlayer: Flip backward and [Channelling|Channel] to charge your [Quarterstaff] with [Lightning]. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] performs a [Lightning]-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. [PerfectTiming|Perfectly Timed] dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] in its wake. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
descriptions.GelidPalmPlayer: When you [Hit] with [Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], projects icy wind which deal [Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals].
descriptions.GeminiSurgePlayer: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.
descriptions.GhostDancePlayer: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are [Hit] while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] based on your [Evasion].
descriptions.GlacialBoltAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with icy bolts that create two walls of [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] at the end of their flight.
descriptions.GlacialBoltPlayer: Fire an icy bolt that creates two walls of [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] at the end of its flight.
descriptions.GlacialCascadePlayer: Sweep your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. [Frozen|Frozen] enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the [Freeze] is [Consume|Consumed]. [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] hit by the final spike explode.
descriptions.GlacialLancePlayer: Throw a single [Pierce|Piercing] lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments [Chill] nearby enemies. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first [Projectile] to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.
descriptions.GrimFeastPlayer: While active, your [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim [Remnant] on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to [Reviving|Revive] up to that much total Life of dead [Minion|Minions].
descriptions.GrimFeastResummonPlayer: Consume stored [Minion] Life to [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. [Reviving|Revives] as many [Minion|Minions] as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.
descriptions.GrimPillarsPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause damaging [IceCrystals|Ice-Crystal] spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of [Cold] damage.
descriptions.HailstormRoundsAmmoPlayer: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to [Ammunition|Load] the accumulated bolts into your [Crossbow]. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
descriptions.HammerOfTheGodsPlayer: Build [Glory] by [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, [Slam|Slamming] into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
descriptions.HandOfChayulaPlayer: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, triggering socketed [Mark|Marks] with increased effect and applying socketed [Curse|Curses] with increased duration.
descriptions.HarbingerOfMadnessPlayer: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and [Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] enemies you [Hit], turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
descriptions.HeraldOfAshPlayer: While active, enemies you sufficiently [Overkill] with non-[Herald] [Attack|Attacks] will cause an explosion that [Ignite|Ignites] nearby enemies based on the [Overkill] damage dealt.
descriptions.HeraldOfBloodPlayer: While active, killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon], but is partially based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic], and has a chance to [Aggravate] [Bleeding].
descriptions.HeraldOfIcePlayer: While active, [Shatter|Shattering] an enemy with a non-[Herald] [Attack] [Hit] will cause an icy explosion that deals [Attack|Attack] damage to surrounding enemies.
descriptions.HeraldOfPlaguePlayer: While active, killing a [Poison|Poisoned] enemy spreads its [Poison] to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also [Hinder] them.
descriptions.HeraldOfThunderPlayer: While active, killing [Shock|Shocked] enemies with a non-[Herald] [Attack] [Hit] will cause subsequent [Attack|Attack] [Hit|Hits] to release lightning bolts which deal[Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies.
descriptions.HexblastPlayer: Detonate a [Curse] on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of [Chaos] damage but removing the [Curse]. Can only detonate [Curse|Curses] for which at least half of the duration has expired.
descriptions.HighVelocityRoundsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that apply [RivenArmour|Riven Armour] to enemies with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour], causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.
descriptions.HighVelocityRoundsPlayer: Fire a powerful [Pierce|Piercing] bolt that applies [RivenArmour|Riven Armour] to enemies with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour], causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.
descriptions.HisFoulEmergencePlayer: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving [WitheringGround|Withering Ground] in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
descriptions.HisWinnowingFlamePlayer: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Fire] damage to enemies and [Consume|Consuming] [Ignite] to create pillars of flame. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].
descriptions.HollowFocusPlayer: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your [Hit|Hits] immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. The bells are themselves always [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun], they can be [CullingStrike|Culled], and [Hit|Hits] against them are always [Critical|Critical Hits].
descriptions.HollowResonancePlayer: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. [Critical|Critical Hits] with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.
descriptions.HollowShellPlayer: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby [Allies] [Guard].
descriptions.HyenaCacklePlayer: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena [Companion|Companions]. The cackle is treated as a single [Companion] for effects that count or limit [Companion|Companions], regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, [Hinder|Hindering] nearby enemies, and have a chance to [Maim] enemies they [Hit].
descriptions.IceNovaPlayer: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt [Projectile] will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to leave a patch of [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].
descriptions.IceShardsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
descriptions.IceStrikePlayer: Perform a fast icy [Strike]. Using this [Attack|Attack] three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
descriptions.IceTippedArrowsPlayer: Ready your active [Bow] or [Spear], [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear] [Attack|Attacks] to [Conversion|Convert] [Physical] Damage to [Cold] Damage and [Trigger] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on [Hit]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] [Sustained] Skills.
descriptions.IcestormPlayer: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. [Chill] and [Freeze] on enemies in front of you are [Consume|Consumed] to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
descriptions.ImpurityPlayer: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Chaos Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
descriptions.IncendiaryShotAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and [Ignite|Igniting] enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.IncendiaryShotPlayer: Fire flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and [Ignite|Igniting] enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.IncineratePlayer: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of [Fire] from your hand, [Ignite|Igniting] enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you [Channelling|Channel]. [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to also create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
descriptions.InevitableAgonyPlayer: [Debuff] all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from [Hit|Hits] to be tracked by the [Debuff]. When the [Debuff|debuff's] duration expires or can kill the target, the target [LifeLoss|loses life] equal to that tracked damage all at once.
descriptions.InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer: The enemy's [Corpse|Corpse] violently explodes, dealing [Fire|Fire] damage in an area around it.
descriptions.InfernalCryPlayer: Perform a [Warcry], [Empowered|Empowering] subsequent [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.IntoTheBreachPlayer: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby [FlamesOfChayula|Flames of Chayula]. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
descriptions.IronWardPlayer: While active, stores a percentage of the [Physical] damage that is prevented by your [Armour] or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
descriptions.KillingPalmPlayer: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [CullingStrike|Cullable] targets in range if your target was [CullingStrike|Culled]. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a [Charges|Power Charge], with higher [Rarity] monsters granting additional [Charges]. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.
descriptions.LeapSlamPlayer:
Jump into the air, damaging and [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
descriptions.LeylinesPlayer: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful [Spell] damage boost but constantly drains your [Ward|Runic Ward]. Running out of [Ward|Runic Ward] causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
descriptions.LifeRemnantsPlayer: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a target spawns a Life [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Life [Remnant] grants you Life which can [Overflow|Overflow] maximum Life.
descriptions.LightningArrowPlayer: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams at nearby enemies.
descriptions.LightningBoltPlayer: Call down a [Shock|Shocking] bolt of [Lightning] to strike enemies in a small area.
descriptions.LightningConduitPlayer: Call down [Lightning] to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to [Shock|Shocked] enemies. If there is a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
descriptions.LightningRodPlayer: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning|Lightning] beams can [Chain|Chain] to it. When [Chain|Chained] to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
descriptions.LightningSpearPlayer: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt [Projectile|Projectiles] at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
descriptions.LightningWarpPlayer: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [Debuff] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning [Projectile|Projectiles]. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals [Lightning|Lightning] damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground]. Creates a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be [CullingStrike|Culled].
descriptions.LingeringIllusionPlayer: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a [Remnant] that grants you a [Charges|Power Charge] on pickup.
descriptions.LivingBombPlayer: Plant a seed of [Fire] inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a [ElementalInfusion|Fire Infusion] [Remnant].
descriptions.LunarAssaultPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
descriptions.MagmaBarrierPlayer: While active, increases your [ChanceToBlock|Block Chance] passively and imbues your [Shield] with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next [Block|Block] with your [Shield] raised will expend the lava to [Trigger] the Magma Spray skill and grant you an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.MagneticSalvoPlayer: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other [Lightning] [Attack|Attacks] in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
descriptions.MalicePlayer: While active, emits an [Aura] that continuously inflicts [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness] on enemies in your [Presence].
descriptions.ManaDrainPlayer: [ManaLeech|Leech] Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly [Hinder|Hindering] them.
descriptions.ManaRemnantsPlayer: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] have a chance to spawn a Mana [Remnant], and [Critical|Critically Hitting] a target with [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] spawns a Mana [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Mana [Remnant] grants you Mana which can [Overflow|Overflow] maximum Mana.
descriptions.ManaTempestPlayer: Create a storm of arcane energies that [Empowered|Empowers] your Mana-costing [Spell|Spells] while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.
descriptions.ManifestWeaponPlayer: Manifest a copy of your main hand [Melee] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon] as an immortal [Companion] to fight by your side. In addition to its standard [Strike|Strikes], the Manifested Weapon gains an additional [Attack] depending on its weapon type.
descriptions.MantraOfDestructionPlayer: Build [Combo|Combo] by successfully [Strike|Striking] Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum [Combo|Combo], use this skill to [Empowered|Empower] your next [Quarterstaff] [Attack], causing it to deal additional [Chaos] damage. Each kill with the [Empowered] [Attack] grants [PurpleFlamesOfChayula|Purple Flames of Chayula] for a duration.
descriptions.MeditatePlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to [ESRecharge|Recharge Energy Shield] and allow that [ESRecharge|Recharge] to [Overflow|Overflow]. [Channelling] ends when you take damage or your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is fully [Overflow|Overflowed].
descriptions.MeleeGrenadeLauncherPlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.
descriptions.MetaAnimusSplintersPlayer: Expend a large amount of [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled], [Remote], Cooldown or [Conditional] Skills, or summon [Minion|Minions].
descriptions.MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is damaged by Enemy [Hit|Hits]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastCurseOnBlockPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Block|Block] and triggers socketed [Curse|Curses] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastFireSpellOnHitPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Hit] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed [Fire] spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastLightningSpellOnHitPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Hit] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed [Lightning] spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnBlockPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Block|Block] and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnCharmUsePlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when one of your [Charm|Charms] is used and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnCritPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Critical|Critically Hit] enemies and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnDodgePlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Freeze], [Shock], or [Ignite] enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnMeleeKillPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you kill enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnMeleeStunPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Stun] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].
descriptions.MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer: While active, gains [Energy] when one of your [Persistent] [Minion|Minions] is [MinionDeath|Killed], and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] upon reaching maximum [Energy]. Very underlevelled [Minion|Minions] will incur an [Energy] generation penalty. Cannot socket [Spell|Spells] which create [Minion|Minions].
descriptions.MetaDeadeyeMarksPlayer: Applies a socketed [Mark] Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. [Consume|Consuming] socketed [Mark|Marks] will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.
descriptions.MetaElementalInvocationPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
descriptions.MetaFeralInvocationPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to create visages which attack once with a socketed [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] [Attack], creating multiple visages if it has enough [Energy].
descriptions.MetaHollowFormPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed [Melee] [Attack] once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled] Skills or [Conditional] Skills. Consuming a [Charges|Power Charge] creates additional images.
descriptions.MetaMirageArcherPlayer: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged [Attack|Attacks] for a short duration, then vanish.
descriptions.MetaMirageDeadeyePlayer: While active, firing a ranged [Projectile] [Attack] will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged [Attack|Attacks] for a short duration, then vanish.
descriptions.MetaMortarCannonPlayer: Raise a cannon [Ballista] [Totem] which uses socketed [Grenade] Skills, with significantly improved [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate].
descriptions.MetaReapersInvocationPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you kill an enemy with a [Melee] [Attack]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
descriptions.MetaRemnantsOfKalguurPlayer: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].
descriptions.MetaSpellslingerPlayer: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you cast [Spell|Spells]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
descriptions.MidnightStarPlayer: While active, [Critical] [Hit|Hits] with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be [Consume|Consumed] to create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] near the most recent target.
descriptions.MirrorOfRefractionPlayer: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your [Presence] periodically. [Hit|Hitting] a mirror with a [Spell] [Projectile] causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
descriptions.MoltenBlastPlayer: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The [Projectile] explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
descriptions.MoltenCrashPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, [Slam|Slamming] twice and creating [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures]. [Consume|Consumes] [Rage] to create additional [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures].
descriptions.MomentOfVulnerabilityPlayer: Send out a temporal [Nova] to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. [Hit|Hitting] enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun], [PrimedElectrocution|Electrocution], or [PrimedFreeze|Freeze] causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of [Immobilised|Immobilisation] used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.
descriptions.NightfallEmbraceTheFallPlayer: Teleport to your thrown [Shield], appearing in the air and [Slam|Slamming] it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.
descriptions.NightfallSoaringMidnightPlayer: Hurl your [Shield] as a [Projectile] which [Return|Returns] to you at the end of its flight. While the [Shield] is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the [Shield] as it [Return|Returns], or destroy an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with the Embrace the Fall.
descriptions.OilBarragePlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and spit [Oil] at enemies, creating [OilGround|Oil Ground] where the [Projectile|Projectiles] land. Consumes [Charges|Power Charges] if possible to instead [Channelling|Channel] a sustained barrage of electrified [Oil] that does not create [OilGround|Oil Ground]. [Projectile|Projectiles] are fired in sequence, allowing multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] to [Hit] the same target.
descriptions.OilGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that bursts in a spray of [Oil] when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the [OilGround|ground] and nearby enemies in [Oil]. Oil created this way can be [Ignite|Ignited] by [Detonator] Skills or [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground].
descriptions.OrbOfStormsPlayer: Create an [Orb|Orb] of electricity that fires [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] bolts at nearby enemies. The [Orb] leaves behind a [ElementalInfusion|Lightning Infusion] [Remnant] when it expires.
descriptions.OverwhelmingPresencePlayer: While active, emits an [Aura] that makes enemies in your [Presence] easier to [Stun] and inflict [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] upon.
descriptions.ParryPlayer: Ready your [Buckler] to parry the next [Hit] you would take, [Block|Blocking] the [Hit] and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased [Attack] damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot [Evasion|Evade] a [Hit] you could parry, but [Evasion] instead grants an equal chance to avoid this [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup.
descriptions.PerfectStrikePlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up your weapon with [Fire]. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] will create a damaging wave of intense [Fire].
descriptions.PermafrostBoltsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at [Freeze|Freezing] enemies. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.PermafrostBoltsPlayer: Fire icy bolts that  fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at [Freeze|Freezing] enemies. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
descriptions.PhantasmalArrowPlayer: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to [Ignite]. [Ignite|Igniting] any enemy with the Explosion also applies [Ignite] to enemies within range.
descriptions.PinnacleOfPowerPlayer: Consume all [Charges|Power Charges] to master the elements, gaining [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] and the ability to apply [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum [Charges|Power Charges].
descriptions.PlagueBearerPlayer: While active, stores a portion of the [Poison] Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored [Poison|Poison] to damage and [Poison] enemies around you.
descriptions.PlagueBurstPlayer: [Trigger|Triggered] when an enemy [Poison|Poisoned] by a supported skill dies, dealing [Physical|Physical] damage around them based on the built-up Plague.
descriptions.PlasmaBlastAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, [Pierce] through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional [Projectile|Projectiles] are fired in a spread, unlike other [Crossbow|Crossbow] Skills.
descriptions.PlasmaBlastPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged. Additional [Projectile|Projectiles] are fired in a spread, unlike other [Crossbow|Crossbow] Skills.
descriptions.PoisonBurstArrowPlayer: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of [Poison|Poison] on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.
descriptions.PowerSiphonPlayer: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within [CullingStrike|Culling] range will be highlighted and instantly killed on [Hit], granting a [Charges|Power Charge]. Can only target Enemies in [CullingStrike|Culling] range.
descriptions.PoweredByVerisiumPlayer: Spends [Ward] to generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusions].
descriptions.PrimalBountyPlayer: [Empowered|Empowers] the next [Projectile] Skill you use, causing it to create additional [Projectile|Projectiles] and fly faster.
descriptions.PrimalStrikesPlayer: Perform a [Lightning]-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they [Hit] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy and refresh [Shock] duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Exposure], and can [Consume] [Shock] to conjure a stampede of spirits.
descriptions.ProfaneRitualPlayer: Mark a [Corpse] with a profane rune, dealing [Chaos] damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the [Corpse] is consumed and you gain a [Charges|Power Charge].
descriptions.PurityOfFirePlayer: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Fire Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
descriptions.PurityOfIcePlayer: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Cold Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
descriptions.PurityOfLightningPlayer: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Lightning Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
descriptions.RagingSpiritsPlayer: While active, [Fire|Fire] [Spell|Spells] you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly [Attack|Attack] them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.
descriptions.RainOfArrowsPlayer: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. [Consume|Consumes] a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] to fire more arrows.
descriptions.RainOfBladesPlayer: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjuring blades. For the duration of the [Buff], these blades fall on enemies [Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].
descriptions.RaiseZombiePlayer: Consume a [Corpse|Corpse] or [Charges|Power Charge] to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from [Charges|Power Charges] are [Empowered] and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.
descriptions.RakePlayer: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting [Bleeding] on all enemies struck.
descriptions.RapidAssaultPlayer: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts [Bleeding] and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, [Maim|Maiming] them for a duration. [Detonator] Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.
descriptions.RapidShotAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a large clip of heated bolts. [Heat] builds up on your [Crossbow] as you fire them, and reaching maximum [Heat] will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume [Heat] for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
descriptions.RapidShotPlayer: Fire a stream of heated bolts. [Heat] builds up on your [Crossbow] as you fire, and reaching maximum heat will prevent you from firing these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume [Heat] for extra benefits.
descriptions.RavenousSwarmPlayer: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that [Attack] and [Poison] enemies.
descriptions.ReapPlayer: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Physical] damage to enemies and applying [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness]. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].
descriptions.RefutationPlayer: Spends all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to gain a short-duration [Buff] that causes you to [Block] all [Block|Blockable] [Hit|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies from which you've [Block|Blocked] a [Hit]. This [Buff] is removed if you are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned]. While this [Buff] is active, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.
descriptions.ResonatingShieldPlayer: Repeatedly hammer your [Shield|Shield] with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose [Armour|Armour] for a duration. While [Channelling] Resonating Shield, your [Shield|Shield] is raised and you will [Block|Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits.
descriptions.RhoaMountPlayer: Harnesses a [Companion] Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a [Bow] or [Spear]. While mounted you can use [Bow], thrown [Spear], and [Mark] Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being [Hit] will cause [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.
descriptions.RighteousDescentPlayer: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a [DivineFragment|Fragment of Divinity] near you or the targeted location, this attack will [Consume] it when you leap to become [Empowered], dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
descriptions.RitualSacrificePlayer: Sacrifice the [Corpse] of a [Rarity|Rare] Monster to grant you its [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] for a duration, or gain a single random [MonsterModifiers|Modifier] at the cost of your own life force.
descriptions.RollingMagmaPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill[Chain|Chains], bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] or Volcanos will activate them as though they were [Slam|Slammed].
descriptions.RollingSlamPlayer: [Slam|Slam] the ground to [Stun|Stun] enemies and [Knockback|knock them away], then continue forward and perform a devastating second [Slam|Slam].
descriptions.RunicReprievePlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to create a protective bubble all around you, [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] against you. While [Channelling] this Skill, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by [Hit|Hits] you [Block], and damage you take from [Hit|Hits] is also removed from [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] this way causes you to accumulate [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot recover [Ward|Runic Ward] while this Skill is active.
descriptions.RunicTemperingPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are [Hit] while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your [Thorns] damage in an area around your attacker.
descriptions.SacredGroundPlayer: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Buff] to you and [Allies] standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies [Armour], [Evasion] and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
descriptions.SacrificePlayer: While active, your undead [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] can be used in place of [Corpse|Corpses] by your skills, but your [Minion|Minions] [Reviving|Revive] more slowly.
descriptions.SanguineRevelryPlayer: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, [Bleeding] enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a [Bleeding] target spawns a Hateful [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful [Remnant] grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.
descriptions.SavageFuryPlayer: While active, your Fury builds from [Attack|Attacking] enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and [Onslaught] but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.
descriptions.ScatteringCalamityPlayer: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing [Lightning] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
descriptions.ScavengedPlatingPlayer: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. [ArmourBreak|Fully Breaking] an enemy's [Armour] grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's [Rarity], and you gain [Armour] and [Thorns] per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.
descriptions.SeismicCryPlayer: Perform a damaging [Warcry], [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. If an enemy is [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] or a currently [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Slam|Slams] to perform an additional [Aftershock|Aftershock]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.ShardScavengerPlayer: While active, [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze], [Shock], [Ignite], or [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] on an enemy reloads your [Crossbow|Crossbow], restores one cooldown use for your [Grenade|Grenades] and grants a [Buff] causing [Crossbow|Crossbow] [Attack|Attacks] to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.
descriptions.ShatteringConcoctionPlayer: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Cold] [Attack] damage in an area and inflicting [Exposure]. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
descriptions.ShatteringPalmPlayer: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them with an [Attack|Attack] that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals [Attack] damage.
descriptions.ShatteringSpitePlayer: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your [Presence] to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and [Leech] Life from enemies caught in the blast.
descriptions.ShieldBlockPlayer: Raise your [Shield] to [Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits. Release immediately after [Block|Blocking] when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and [Stun|Stunning] enemies. While your [Shield] is raised you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by hits you [Block], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] you. You cannot [Evasion|Evade] while your [Shield] is raised, but [Evasion] instead grants an equal chance to avoid this [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup.
descriptions.ShieldChargePlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your [Shield|Shield] is raised and you will [Block|Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits.
descriptions.ShieldWallPlayer: Ram your [Shield] into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your [Slam|Slams], [Warcry|Warcries], and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.
descriptions.ShockGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that discharges an [Electrocute|Electrocuting] [Lightning] blast when its fuse expires, causing all [Lightning] [Hit|Hits] against enemies to contribute to [Electrocute|Electrocution] buildup for a duration.
descriptions.ShockburstRoundsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon [Hit|Hitting] an enemy affected by a [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailment]. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
descriptions.ShockburstRoundsPlayer: Rapidly fire charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon [Hit|Hitting] an enemy affected by a [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailment]. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
descriptions.ShockchainArrowPlayer: Fire a [Lightning]-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailments]. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and [Chain] towards nearby targets, with those [Chain|Chaining] [Hit|Hits] also releasing a shockwave. After the final [Chain], the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. [Consume|Consumes] [Shock] from enemies it [Hit|Hits], but not [Electrocute|Electrocution].
descriptions.ShockwaveTotemPlayer: Raise a [Totem|Totem] that [Slam|Slams] the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts when hit by this [Slam|Slam], damaging enemies standing on it. The [Totem] cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground]. This Skill can be used while [Shapeshift|Shapeshifted].
descriptions.SiegeBallistaPlayer: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
descriptions.SiegeCascadeAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
descriptions.SigilOfPowerPlayer: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Spell] Damage [Buff] to you and [Allies] while standing in it. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
descriptions.SiphonElementsPlayer: While active, has a chance to create an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] a target.
