descriptions.SiphoningStrikePlayer: Dash to a target and [Strike|Strike] them with your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff]. If the target is [Shock|Shocked], [Consume] their [Shock|Shock] to release a [Lightning|Lightning] shockwave around the target and grant you a [Charges|Power Charge]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
descriptions.SkyfallPlayer: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward]. When you have maximum [Glory], you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion]. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion], if possible, to increase the number of [TemporaryMinion|Minions] summoned.
descriptions.SmashToSmithereensPlayer: Blows strong enough to [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
descriptions.SnapPlayer: [Consume] the elemental energy from a [Frozen], [Shock|Shocked] or [Ignite|Ignited] enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant]. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same [ElementalAilments|Ailment], but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
descriptions.SnipePlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] causes the arrow to explode on impact and [Consume] [Freeze] on directly [Hit|Hitting]. [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze] enhances the explosion.
descriptions.SnipersMarkPlayer: [Mark] a target. The next [Critical|Critical Hit] the target receives [MarkActivate|Activates] the [Mark], [Consume|Consuming] it to deal extra damage and grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge].
descriptions.SolarOrbPlayer: Create a fiery [Orb|Orb] that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the [Orb|Orb] are [Ignite|Ignited]. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
descriptions.SorceryWardPlayer: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] from [Hit|Hits] for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
descriptions.SoulrendPlayer: Fire a [Pierce|Piercing] [Projectile] that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a [Debuff] that [Hinder|Hinders] them and deals [Chaos] damage over time for a short duration.
descriptions.SparkPlayer: Launch a spray of sparking [Projectile|Projectiles] that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
descriptions.SpearOfSolarisPlayer: Build [Glory] by inflicting [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] on enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your [Spear] in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Modifiers to number of [Projectile|Projectiles] fired do not apply to this skill.
descriptions.SpearThrowPlayer: Hurl your [Spear] with force. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if you have one to cause the [Spear] to explode at the end of its flight.
descriptions.SpearfieldPlayer: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and [Maim|Maiming] them.
descriptions.SpiralVolleyPlayer: Load your [Bow] with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes [Charges|Frenzy Charges] to cause the arrows to deal more damage and [Chain] to other targets. Each target can only be [Hit] once.
descriptions.SpiritVesselPlayer: Summons a [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Spirit Vessel [Companion] that uses copies of socketed [Bear], [Werewolf], and [Wyvern] Skills.
descriptions.StaffConsecratePlayer: Create an area of [ConsecratedGround|Consecrated Ground] around you.
descriptions.StaggeringPalmPlayer: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, instantly [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunning] enemies which are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun] and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [PrimedStun|Primed] targets in range if your first target was [HeavyStun|Stunned]. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] an enemy with this Skill grants you a [Buff] that causes your [Quarterstaff] [Attack|Attacks] to also fire [Projectile|Projectiles] for a short duration. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] additional enemies adds to the [Buff]'s duration.
descriptions.StampedePlayer: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping [Slam] damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of [Attack] speed.
descriptions.StarbornOnslaughtPlayer: Build up Glory by [Freeze|Freezing] or [Chill|Chilling] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may jump backwards loosing your [Mace] with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases [MoltenFissure|Fissures] and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.
descriptions.StormLancePlayer: Throw an electrified [Spear] that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with [Lightning] bolts. If the [Spear] is [Detonator|Detonated] by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] on Detonation.
descriptions.StormWavePlayer: Sweep your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff], projecting a bolt of [Lightning] through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.
descriptions.StormblastBoltsAmmoPlayer: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a [Detonator] Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
descriptions.StormblastBoltsPlayer: Aims skyward and fires charged bolts that land around the target location, dealing damage and lodging in the ground for a duration. [Detonator] Skills will cause these bolts to explode. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
descriptions.StormcallerArrowPlayer: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a [Lightning] Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to [Shock]. [Shock|Shocking] any enemy with the Bolt also applies [Shock] to all enemies near the impact.
descriptions.SummonAzmerianWolfPlayer: Summons an ancient [Reviving] Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on [Command]. It [Maim|Maims] when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict [Bleeding], or howl to inspire nearby allies.
descriptions.SummonBeastPlayer: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Beast] [Companion] to aid you in combat.
descriptions.SummonFireDjinnPlayer: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to [Strike] enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating [Fire] [Spell|Spells] when [Command|Commanded] to do so.
descriptions.SummonInfernalHoundPlayer: Activate to summon a [Reviving] Infernal Hound which [Ignite|Ignites] enemies near it.
descriptions.SummonMetaTotemSpellTotemPlayer: Consume any combination of 3 [Charges|Power and/or Endurance Charges] to raise a [Totem] that uses socketed [Spell|Spells]. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.
descriptions.SummonMistRavenPlayer: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be [Command|Commanded] to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] for each enemy it [CullingStrike|Culls].
descriptions.SummonSandDjinnPlayer: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you [Command] him to do so. Kelari delivers swift [Hit|Hits] with massive [Critical|Critical Hit] potential.
descriptions.SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, [Reviving] Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other [Minion|Minions] on [Command].
descriptions.SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer: Activate to summon hard-hitting, [Reviving] Skeletal Brutes that can [Stun] [PrimedStun|Primed] enemies and [Warcry] on [Command]. This [Warcry] [Intimidate|Intimidates] nearby enemies and [Consume|Consumes] [Freeze] on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
descriptions.SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
descriptions.SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your [Minion|Minions] in an icy shield on [Command].
descriptions.SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer: Activate to summon aggressive, [Reviving] Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on [Command]. Skeletal Reavers do more [Attack] Damage and gain increased [Attack] speed based on their [Rage]
descriptions.SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer: Activate to summon long-ranged, [Reviving] Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on [Command].
descriptions.SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on [Command].
descriptions.SummonSpectrePlayer: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a [Reviving] [Minion].
descriptions.SummonSpiralingConspiracyPlayer: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the [Presence] of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can [Command] some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.
descriptions.SummonWaterDjinnPlayer: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn [Minion] to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you [Command] her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your [Allies] with her [Spell|Spells].
descriptions.SunderPlayer: [Slam] the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] applies [SunderedArmour|Sundered Armour], making it take additional increased [Physical] damage.
descriptions.SuperchargedSlamPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to [Slam|Slam] the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by [Aftershock|Aftershocks] dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own [Attack] time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.
descriptions.SupportingFirePlayer: Recruit artillery [Minion|Minions] that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your [Command], then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.
descriptions.TameBeastPlayer: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Beast] for a duration, [Hinder|Hindering] them. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Beast] while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the [MonsterCategory|Beast] as a [Reviving] [Companion].
descriptions.TemperWeaponCombustionPlayer: Explode, dealing [Fire] damage in an area.
descriptions.TemperWeaponPlayer: [Channelling|Channel] to temper your main hand [Melee] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Attack|Attacks] to Combust when [Hit|Hitting] enemies.
descriptions.TempestBellPlayer: Build [Combo|Combo] by successfully [Strike|Striking] Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum [Combo|Combo], use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be [Hit] by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and [Hit|Hits] which would have caused [Knockback] increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
descriptions.TempestFlurryPlayer: Perform a series of aggressive [Strike|Strikes]. When used in quick succession, the third use [Strike|Strikes] three times, and the fourth use performs a [FinalStrike|Final Strike] that calls down a powerful [Shock|Shocking] bolt.
descriptions.TemporalChainsPlayer: [Curse] all enemies in an area, [Slow|Slowing] them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
descriptions.TemporalRiftPlayer: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the [Spell] to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.
descriptions.TheStarsAnswerCometPlayer: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] for a short duration.
descriptions.TheStarsAnswerPlayer: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly [Trigger|Triggering] Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
descriptions.ThunderousLeapPlayer: Leap into the air and plunge your [Spear] into the ground at the target location, emitting a [Lightning]-charged shockwave.
descriptions.ThunderstormPlayer: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become [Shock|Shocked] or [Frozen] more easily. [Plant|Plants] in the area become [Plant|Overgrown].
descriptions.TimeOfNeedPlayer: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove [Curse|Curses] and [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] from you.
descriptions.TornadoPlayer: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals [Physical] damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] absorbs that surface's [Debuff], applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.
descriptions.TornadoShotPlayer: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing [Physical] damage over time and [Hinder|Hindering] enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown [Spear|Spears] and [Crossbow] bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied [Projectile|Projectiles]. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.
descriptions.ToxicDomainPlayer: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be [Poison|Poisoned]. Pustules will [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a duration or when enough [Poison] has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored [Poison] damage and applying [Poison] in an area around it.
descriptions.ToxicGrenadePlayer: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that causes a burst of [Poison|Poison] gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing [Poison|Poison] cloud. [Burning] effects or [Detonator|Detonator] skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
descriptions.ToxicGrowthPlayer: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a delay. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.
descriptions.TriggeredAbyssalApparitionPlayer: Consume a [Charges|Power Charge] when you cast a damaging [Spell] to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same [Spell] for you. Does not work with [Channelling] Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, [Trigger|Triggered] Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a [Charges|Power Charge]. This Skill is not directly Supportable.
descriptions.TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer: Deal [Physical] Area Damage based off of the [ArmourBreak|Broken Armour] of the target which this explosion was [Trigger|Triggered] from.
descriptions.TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer: Deal [Physical] Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the [Pinned] target slain.
descriptions.TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer: Creates [Hazard|Hazardous] Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are [Maim|Maimed]. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time.
descriptions.TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer: Create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] [Ignite|Igniting] Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.
descriptions.TriggeredCaltropsPlayer: [Maim|Maims] and deals [Attack] area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.
descriptions.TriggeredCatalysingDischargePlayer: [Trigger|Triggered] when supported skill is boosted by an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] to deal damage of the matching [ElementalDamage|Element].
descriptions.TriggeredCorruptingCryPlayer: Covers the target in [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] which damages them.
descriptions.TriggeredCorruptingCryThreePlayer: Covers the target in large quantities of [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] which severely damages them.
descriptions.TriggeredCorruptingCryTwoPlayer: Covers the target in [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] which damages them.
descriptions.TriggeredCreepingChillPlayer: Creates spreading [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] around [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] created by Supported Skills.
descriptions.TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer: Explodes and deals [Chaos] Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported [Curse] on [Hit].
descriptions.TriggeredDeadlyCurrentPlayer: Sends a [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] [Projectile] from the [Shock|Shocked] enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing [Spell] damage.
descriptions.TriggeredDeadlyResolvePlayer: Creates a deadly slash towards the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon].
descriptions.TriggeredDecayingHexPlayer: Inflicts Decay on the target, dealing [Chaos] Damage over time.
descriptions.TriggeredElementalDischargePlayer: [Trigger|Triggered] when supported skill [Consume|Consumes] [Ignite], [Shock], or [Freeze], to deal damage of [DamageTypes|Types] matching the [Consume|Consumed] [ElementalAilments|Ailments].
descriptions.TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]
descriptions.TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]
descriptions.TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer: Deal [Fire] Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the [Consume|Consumed] [Ignite].
descriptions.TriggeredFracturedSelfPlayer: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the [Trigger|Triggering] [Spell]. If you reach the [Limit] of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their [Spell|Spells] and disappear.
descriptions.TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer: Deal [Physical] Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the [Consume|Consumed] [Bleeding].
descriptions.TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer: Deal [Fire] Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the [Consume|Consumed] [Ignite].
descriptions.TriggeredManifestRunePlayer: Summon a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Verisium Manifestation] that launches [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] at enemies.
descriptions.TriggeredMoltenShowerPlayer: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
descriptions.TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which [DetonationTime|Detonates] after a delay, dealing [Attack] damage. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.
descriptions.TriggeredQuillburstPlayer: Deal your [Thorns] Damage in an Area. Cannot [Hit] the target this was [Trigger|Triggered] from.
descriptions.TriggeredShockingRiftPlayer: Pull enemies in and pulse [Lightning] damage, [Hinder|Hindering] enemies [Hit]. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.
descriptions.TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer: Creates Skittering Stone [Minion|Minions] from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
descriptions.TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo: Creates Skittering Stone [Minion|Minions] from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
descriptions.TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems: Deals [Physical] Damage in an area, based on [Totem] Life.
descriptions.TriggeredStaticShocksPlayer: Attaches a Static Shock to a target that pulses [Lightning] damage to the attached target and nearby enemies. Targets can have a maximum of one Static Shock attached to them.
descriptions.TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl: Explodes to deal [Cold] Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.
descriptions.TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsPlayer: [Maim|Maims] and deals [Attack] area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.
descriptions.TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer: Fire molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the struck target, which will land nearby dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
descriptions.TriggeredXibaquasRendingPlayer: Deals [Fire] damage in an area around the exploding [Corpse] based on its maximum Life.
descriptions.TrinityPlayer: Become attuned to all [ElementalDamage|Elements] building up Fire, Cold and Lightning [Affinity] based off the highest [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] type dealt by your [Hit|Hits]. Your [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] is enhanced the more [Affinity] of any type you have.
descriptions.TriskelionCascadePlayer: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast. The [Empowered] [Spell] becomes centred on your location, and [Cascadable|Cascades] to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
descriptions.TwisterPlayer: Whip up a twister with a flick of your [Spear]. The twister moves forward erratically, [Blind|Blinding] and repeatedly [Hit|Hitting] enemies within. If a twister touches a [Whirlwind] from your other skills, it Consumes the [Whirlwind] to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surfaces] or Consuming an elemental [Whirlwind] will grant twisters extra damage of that element.
descriptions.UnboundAvatarPlayer: Gain [UnboundFury|Unbound Fury] by inflicting [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] with [Hit|Hits] on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
descriptions.UnearthPlayer: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of [Corpse|Corpses] and dead [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct [Minion|Minions] that fight for you. Larger [Corpse|Corpses] create more than one Bone Construct.
descriptions.UniqueAtziriHeraldPlayer: Killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon Damage], but is based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic].
descriptions.UniqueBreachLightningBoltPlayer: Call down a [Shock|Shocking] bolt of [Lightning] to strike enemies in a small area.
descriptions.UnleashPlayer: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, [Empowered|Empowering] the next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Spell] you cast to [Repeat|Repeat] multiple times. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] Skills with a Cooldown.
descriptions.ValakosChargePlayer: While active, taking [Lightning] damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to [Trigger] this skill, creating a [Chain|Chaining] lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.
descriptions.VaultingImpactPlayer: Leap forward and [Slam] the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies [BrokenStance|Broken Stance] to [Daze|Dazed] enemies, causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.
descriptions.VerisiumManifestationPlayer: While active, [Hit|Hitting] with an [Attack] will spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion] that rapidly [Attack|Attacks] nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.
descriptions.VileDisruptionPlayer: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [Debuff] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals [Physical|Physical] damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts [Impale|Impale].
descriptions.VineArrowPlayer: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, [Slow|Slowing] their movement speed and dealing [Chaos] damage over time. The plant can be [Poison|Poisoned], causing it to deal more damage.
descriptions.VirtuousBarrierPlayer: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each [Attributes|Attribute] type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are [Hit].
descriptions.VividStampedePlayer: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground].
descriptions.VolatileDeadPlayer: Consume a [Corpse] to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and [Ignite|Ignites] enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
descriptions.VolcanicFissurePlayer: [Slam|Slam] the ground, creating a branching [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissure] that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different [Slam] on a [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissure] creates a spreading [Aftershock].
descriptions.VolcanoPlayer: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten [Projectile|Projectiles]. While the volcano persists, [Slam|Slamming] it will cause another [Projectile] spray. [Channelling] this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent [Projectile] sprays.
descriptions.VoltaicBarrierPlayer: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and [Electrocute|Electrocuting] enemies caught between them. [Projectile|Projectiles] you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on [Hit] as [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams.
descriptions.VoltaicMarkPlayer: [Mark] a target, making them more susceptible to being [Electrocute|Electrocuted]. When the [Mark|Marked] target is [Electrocute|Electrocuted], the [Mark] [MarkActivate|Activates], granting a [Buff] which gives extra [Lightning] damage and [Consume|Consuming] the [Mark]. [Mark|Marking] another target while you have the [Buff] will remove the [Buff].
descriptions.VulnerabilityPlayer: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, making [Hit|Hits] against them ignore a portion of their [Armour|Armour].
descriptions.WalkingCalamityPlayer: Build [Glory] by gaining [Rage] while already at maximum [Rage]. When you have maximum [Glory], roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you [Gain] [Fire] damage and [Rage] regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave [Bear] form, but will resume if you return to [Bear] form before the duration expires.
descriptions.WarBannerReservationPlayer: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [Attack] damage, [Attack] speed and [Accuracy].
descriptions.WardboundMinionsPlayer: Spend all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon [TemporaryMinion|Temporary] Wardbound Casters. These [Minion|Minions] target nearby enemies with damaging [Cold] [Spell|Spells].
descriptions.WaveOfFrostPlayer: Flip backwards and send forth a [Freeze|Freezing] wave in front of you, immediately [Freeze|Freezing] enemies which are [PrimedFreeze|Primed for Freeze].
descriptions.WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer: Fire a burst of [Chaos] energy at the target.
descriptions.WhirlingAssaultPlayer: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning [Strike|Strikes].
descriptions.WhirlingSlashPlayer: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a [Whirlwind] around you, [Slow|Slowing] enemies and [Blind|Blinding] them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing [Knockback].
descriptions.WhirlwindLancePlayer: Throw a [Spear] with enough force to kick up a [Whirlwind] where it lands, [Slow|Slowing] enemies and [Blind|Blinding] them in its area of effect. Entering the [Whirlwind] collapses it, dealing damage and causing [Knockback]. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to create the [Whirlwind] with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.
descriptions.WildProtectorPlayer: Call upon a Bear Spirit [Companion] to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to [Maim] them, [Leech|Leeches] Life with its slam, and periodically roars to [Intimidate] enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your [Companion] limit.
descriptions.WindDancerPlayer: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more [Evasion] per stage. Being [Hit] by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and [Knockback|Knock Back] enemies around you.
descriptions.WindSerpentsFuryPlayer: Consume all [Charges|Frenzy Charges] to perform a gigantic spear thrust that [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies. For each [Charges|Frenzy Charge] consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies.
descriptions.WingBlastPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies. Enemies [PrimedStun|Primed] for [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a [Charges|Power Charge]. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
descriptions.WitherPlayer: Channel a debilitating hex that [Withered|Withers] enemies in the area.
descriptions.WitheringPresencePlayer: While active, emits an [Aura] that periodically [Withered|Withers] enemies in your [Presence].
descriptions.WolfArcticHowlPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and [Freeze|Freezes] [PrimedFreeze|Primed] enemies. If an enemy is [Frozen] or a [Frozen] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] your attacks with added [Cold] damage, causes [Empowered] [Slam|Slams] to create [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground], and grants your [Allies] added [Cold] damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
descriptions.WolfCrossSlashPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be [Hit] separately by both gouges. [Hit|Hitting] a [Mark|Marked] enemy with both gouges will [MarkActivate|Activate] the [Mark] and cause an additional shockwave. [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
descriptions.WolfLunarBlessingPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and offer your [Rage] to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus [Cold] damage for yourself and any Wolf [Minion|Minions] you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all [Rage] to extend the [Buff]'s duration. While the [Buff] is active, your [Werewolf] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] call down Moonbeams on [Hit].
descriptions.WolfPackPlayer: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf [Companion|Companions]. The pack treated as a single [Companion] for effects that count or limit [Companion|Companions], regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.
descriptions.WolfPounceMarkPlayer: [Mark] a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the [Mark] will [MarkActivate|Activate] to [Trigger] the Summon Wolf skill and [Consume] the [Mark].
descriptions.WolfPouncePlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be [Trigger|Triggered] targeting the highest [Rarity] enemy [Hit], or if a [Mark] gem is socketed into this Skill, that [Mark] will be [Trigger|Triggered] instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf [Minion|Minions] you have to leap immediately.
descriptions.WolfPounceSummonWolfPlayer: This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] when Predator's Mark [MarkActivate|Activates] to Summon a Wolf [Minion] that follows you as long as it lives.
descriptions.WolfShredPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first [Attack] can dash to faraway enemies and the final [Attack] [Strike|Strikes] twice. [Attack|Attacking] a [Frozen] enemy will create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments], which are [Projectile|Projectiles] that land and explode after a short delay.
descriptions.WyvernDevourPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and devour a [Corpse] or [CullingStrike|Cullable] enemy, and additional nearby [Corpse|Corpses]. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a [Charges|Power Charge]. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a [Slam].
descriptions.WyvernFlameBreathPlayer: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. [Channelling] ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending [Rage]. Consumes a [Charges|Power Charge] if possible to [Empowered|Empower] the Skill, [Gain|Gaining] extra [Lightning] damage and spending [Rage] more slowly.
